title: Evidence-Grounded Mapping of Multimodal Human Sensing Psychological Transdiagnostic Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2608.24903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile and wearable sensing enables longitudinal observation of behavior, yet translating these signals into meaningful mental health constructs remains difficult. We introduce a clinician-in-the-loop benchmark for evaluating whether large language models (LLMs) can generate evidence-grounded Brief Hierarchical Taxonomy of Psychopathology (B-HiTOP) item profiles from passive sensing, ecological momentary assessment (EMA), and questionnaire evidence. Using the Generalization of Longitudinal Behavior Modeling (GLOBEM) dataset, we construct 14,592 participant-day instances and align multimodal evidence to 29 B-HiTOP items across five spectra. Since GLOBEM lacks B-HiTOP responses, we evaluate evidence compatibility (C) rather than diagnostic accuracy, separating substantive predictions from abstentions when evidence is insufficient for item-level scoring. translated_title: 基于证据的多模态人类感知心理跨诊断维度映射
translated_abstract: 移动和可穿戴传感技术能够实现对行为的纵向观察，但将这些信号转化为有意义的心理健康构念仍然困难。我们引入了一个临床医生参与的基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）是否能够从被动传感、生态瞬时评估（EMA）和问卷证据中生成基于证据的简短精神病理学分层分类法（B-HiTOP）项目概况。使用纵向行为建模泛化（GLOBEM）数据集，我们构建了14,592个参与者日实例，并将多模态证据与跨越五个谱系的29个B-HiTOP项目对齐。由于GLOBEM缺乏B-HiTOP响应，我们评估证据兼容性（C）而非诊断准确性，在证据不足以进行项目级评分时，区分实质性预测与弃权。两阶段预测提高了EMA和问卷证据的C值，但降低了其他方面的表现。
tldr: 本文提出了一种临床医生参与的基准方法，利用大型语言模型从多模态传感数据中生成基于证据的心理病理学维度映射，并采用证据兼容性评估而非传统诊断准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a clinician-in-the-loop benchmark that uses large language models to generate evidence-grounded psychopathological dimension profiles from multimodal sensing data, evaluating evidence compatibility rather than diagnostic accuracy.
